leads.title: Rhode Island anti-discrimination law - sexual orientation (1995), gender identity or expression (2001), healthcare expansion (June 2023)
leads.documents: Statewide ban on discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, credit, housing, public accommodations, and explicitly patient care/nursing/healthcare from 2023; plus July 2021 bills on pay disclosure and repeal of 1995 housing 3-occupiers-or-less loophole effective Jan 1, 2023.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: outlawed since 1995/2001; June 2023 bill passed both houses and signed by Governor of Rhode Island; July 2021 two bills signed, effective January 1, 2023

leads.title: Rhode Island hate crimes criminal statute - penalty enhancements
leads.documents: Criminal penalty enhancements for crimes motivated by victim's actual or perceived sexual orientation or gender identity or expression, among other categories.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as state criminal statute covering hate crimes motivated by both sexual orientation and gender identity or expression

leads.title: H 5277 Substitute A - Conversion Therapy Prohibition / Rhode Island General Assembly
leads.documents: Prohibits conversion therapy on minors and bans funding by state and political subdivisions; legislative history and enactment.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: introduced Jan 27, 2017 by Reps. Edith Ajello, Joseph McNamara, Susan Donovan, J. Aaron Regunberg, Moira Walsh; House 69-0 May 30, Senate 29-0 June 2017, House re-pass 62-0; signed July 19, 2017 by Governor Gina Raimondo, effective immediately

leads.title: 2018 repeal of gay and trans panic defense / Rhode Island General Assembly
leads.documents: Repeals gay and trans panic defense as criminal defense; shows enforcement/rights machinery for LGBTQ defendants/victims.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: passed June 2018 by 68-2 House, 27-0 Senate; signed a month later by Governor Gina Raimondo, effective immediately

leads.title: Rhode Island Department of Health regulations on birth certificate gender designation - Oct 23, 2014 and X option
leads.documents: Removes surgery requirement; allows change via Birth Certificate Request Form plus affidavit from physician/certified nurse practitioner/physician assistant confirming transgender status; later adds X third gender option.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: new regulations effective Oct 23, 2014; Aug 2019 announcement by Dept. of Health that from July 2020 licenses and birth certificates would include X alongside male/female

leads.title: Rhode Island Division of Motor Vehicles Gender Designation Form / driver's license policy
leads.documents: DMV issuance of updated driver's license with corrected gender marker upon receipt of Gender Designation Form signed by applicant; later X option.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: Gender Designation Form signed by applicant; Aug 2019 Dept. of Health and DMV announcement of X option from July 2020

leads.title: June 2018 transgender death certificate accuracy bill / Rhode Island General Assembly
leads.documents: Ensures transgender people are correctly recorded on death certificates.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: passed June 2018 General Assembly, signed by Governor Gina Raimondo, effective immediately

leads.title: July 2021 single-occupancy gender-neutral bathrooms law - effective Jan 1, 2022
leads.documents: Legally allows gender-neutral bathrooms for single occupancy toilets; public-accommodations access relevant to trans visitors.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: bill signed July 2021 by Governor of Rhode Island, effective January 1, 2022; noted California, New York State, Illinois and New Mexico have similar laws

leads.title: Rhode Island Interscholastic League (RIIL) transgender athletes policy update - March 2025
leads.documents: Current enforcement status: transgender athletes remain able to compete for RIIL-sanctioned teams but member schools responsible for ensuring compliance with all applicable state and federal law when determining gender-based eligibility; sparked protest/petition.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as: March 2025 update; petition organizer & teacher Syed Menebhi demanded return to previous policy that allowed participation consistent with gender identity

leads.title: Public Religion Research Institute (PRRI) 2022 poll / Movement Advancement Project Equality Profile
leads.documents: Institutional/human-rights context: 80% support same-sex marriage (14% opposed, 5% unsure), 84% support discrimination protections (9% opposed, 8% unsure); MAP/Equaldex profiles aggregate legal status.
leads.detail: External links visible: LGBT Rights in Rhode Island via Equaldex; Rhode Island's Equality Profile via Movement Advancement Project; poll cited as 2022 PRRI poll
